conditions: Operator rulings: 2026-11-21 (the managing repository's session picker, relayed as data: the managing team performs GitHub operations in the repositories it manages, 'Tier 1 + merges, not governance', through the fleet-agent GitHub App) and 2026-11-22 (researchteam session picker: the one-week pilot row fleet-agent-pilot-2026-11 lapses and is replaced by a new authorization under a new id; the exception cap is raised to two). This row is that authorization, for researchteam only, expiring 2027-02-21. Granted: the private GitHub App fleet-agent-jlcatonjr may act on jlcatonjr/researchteam as a separate agent identity, only through the managing repository's wrapper scripts/agent_gh.sh, at wrapper Tier 1: read; create, edit and comment on issues; create pull requests (only with --head), edit and comment on them; push working branches; draft release pages for tags that already exist. Not granted: merges and approvals (a merge by the App is not accepted by researchteam under this row; PS-2 is unchanged); pushes to main, dev, release/**, archive/**, chore/agentteams-autosync or tags; force pushes and deletions; published releases; secrets, variables, rulesets, workflows, settings, keys; GraphQL and non-GET API calls. Tier 1 work is coordinated with researchteam's orchestrator and needs no per-action row. Standing conditions: the rulesets on main, release/**, archive/** and all tags stay as read back below; the App's installation permissions stay contents, issues and pull_requests write, and checks, actions and metadata read, nothing else; this is attribution, not a security boundary (the App key is readable by the agent's operating-system user, so the installation's permissions and the rulesets are the real ceiling). A change to the wrapper's tier, to the App's permissions or to those rulesets ends the basis of this row. Relaxed: the rule that a managing repository's agent writes nothing in this repository. The row changes no PS-2 delegation, signs nothing, and grants no write to another repository. Continuing after the expiry needs a new row.
